Docket 1.3.148

**Docket is free to try: run a full audit of any site without a key and see your score, how many problems each area has, and the most important problem in full with its fix. [Buy it once](https://kerr-affiliate-hub.kerrco.workers.dev/buy/docket?src=release-notes), $59, or $29.50 at the Black Friday price until 30 November, to see all the others, the ranked fix plan and the markup to paste. 30-day refund, no conditions.**

- *A site that blocks Google comes first.* When robots.txt shut out every crawler, Google included, the most
  important problem was the one about AI crawlers, and its fix let those in while Google stayed blocked. The site
  being closed to Google now comes first, and the AI crawler problem says the same fix covers it.
- *A software company with an office is not a local business.* An app or software site with its office address and
  phone number in the footer was scored as a local business, with local problems it does not have. It now gets
  the local checks only if something says it serves customers in a place, such as opening hours or a local
  business type.

99 checks across 13 areas.
